g.text: The checkout flow, now inside the Order Service (ADR-0007): Order publishes OrderPlaced to the Message Broker and continues to payment without waiting for Inventory in the Webshop Monolith (ADR-0006); the card is authorised through Stripe (ADR-0004), Inventory reserves the stock asynchronously, and the payment is captured once StockReserved arrives.

g.data-qualified-name: Webshop.n.size.16..Software System...size..Order Service.n.size.16..Container. Java. Spring Boot...size.
Webshop.n.size.16..Software System...size..Order Service.n.size.16..Container. Java. Spring Boot...size..Webshop.OrderService.Order

g.text: 1: Reviews the cart and clicks Pay
3: Publishes OrderPlaced via the transactional outbox (checkout does not wait for Inventory)
4: Requests payment for the order total
8: Marks the order as payment authorised
5: Creates a payment intent with manual capture (its client secret goes back to the Web Application)
6: Confirms the payment with the card details (the card is authorised, not charged yet)
9: Delivers OrderPlaced; Inventory reserves the stock (idempotent on the order ID)
